data.name: Dodgeball Disorder
data.detailed_description:
DODGEBALL DISORDER

Dodgeball Disorder is a chaotic online multiplayer dodgeball game where throwing the ball is only half the battle. Dodge, catch, aim, and send your opponents flying with physics-based hits, ridiculous ragdoll reactions and face expressions.

Step into a school gym where a normal dodgeball match has somehow turned into complete disorder. Play with or against other players, survive the chaos, and try to leave with at least a small amount of dignity.

THROW. DODGE. SURVIVE.

Every hit matters. Time your throws, avoid incoming balls and use movement to stay in the fight. Hard hits can send players tumbling across the gym with physics-driven reactions.

DIFFERENT WAYS TO CAUSE PROBLEMS

Matches can completely change depending on the game mode.

Classic
Score hits for your team. When the match ends, the team with the most hit points wins.

Last Team Standing
Getting hit has consequences. Keep your team alive and make sure the other one runs out of players first.

Free-For-All
No teams. No friends. Everybody is a perfectly acceptable target.

Prison Dodge
Getting hit sends you out of the main play area. Use the recovery zones around enemy territory to fight your way back into the match.

PHYSICS-BASED CHAOS

Players react differently depending on how they are hit. Dodgeballs, movement and ragdoll physics turn simple throws into unpredictable moments.

Sometimes you make the perfect throw.

Sometimes your teammate takes it directly to the face.

Both count as gameplay.

A GYM WITH QUESTIONABLE SUPERVISION

The school gym is filled with props, signs, ridiculous posters and small environmental jokes. Look around between throws — although staring at the walls during a dodgeball match is generally considered a bad survival strategy.

ONLINE MULTIPLAYER

Jump into online matches, compete against other players and communicate using in-game text and voice chat.

Dodgeball Disorder is easy to understand: get the ball, throw the ball, and preferably don't be the person the ball hits.

data.short_description: Dodgeball Disorder is a chaotic online multiplayer dodgeball game where throwing, dodging and staying on your feet are equally important. Score hits, survive ridiculous ragdoll physics and compete across multiple game modes in a school gym with questionable supervision and crazy face expressions.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit (version 21H1 or newer)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200 (4 cores, 3.0 GHz)
  • Memory: 8192 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 260X / Intel UHD 630 (2 GB VRAM, DirectX 11)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600 (6 cores)
  • Memory: 16384 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 6 GB / AMD Radeon RX 580 8 GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card

content_descriptors.notes:
Dodgeball Disorder contains mild cartoon violence, mature humor, and references to recreational drug use. Players throw dodgeballs at each other, causing exaggerated physics-based and ragdoll reactions. There is no blood, gore, dismemberment, or realistic injury.

The game also contains humorous references to cannabis, including a cartoon sun depicted smoking a joint and other cannabis-themed visual references. Anti-drug messages such as “Don’t Do Drugs!” may also appear as environmental decorations. Some environmental text and jokes contain mild crude or dark humor.

The game does not currently contain explicit sexual activity, graphic nudity, self-harm, or sexual violence.
